_comment: Overrides for the inside/outside decision. This is NOT the roster.
Affiliation is derived per run: the contributors API says who has merged
commits, and the compare responses say who authored the commits on every
fork branch. Anyone not named here is decided that way and needs no entry.
Name someone here only when the derived answer is wrong:
inside  - an organisation account that holds repositories for the team,
or a teammate who has not merged anything yet, or someone the
contributors API missed because their commits were squashed
outside - someone the contributors API counts as a contributor who is not
on the team. A reviewer from another project who landed one fix
reads as inside and pushes the outside share down.
A name here beats everything, including the freeze in collect.py. A name in
both lists is an error, not a tie-break. Logins are lowercase.
